proof_requests: Send clear sidewall close-up showing brand + exact size + DOT week/year code.
Send tread proof: close-up of wear bars and/or tread depth gauge readings (mm) at 3–4 points.

response.reason: The seller’s text and “I tested it” claim can’t be verified remotely without new photos/video or measurable details (size, DOT date, tread depth, and inner/sidewall condition). Pricing must remain at worst-case until proof is provided.
